12. The World Wide Web can be represented as a web graph.
(a) Describe how a web graph can be used to represent the connectivity of the
World Wide Web. [4]
The World Wide Web has expanded significantly over the last 10 years. In June 2018, there
were an estimated 1600 million websites and 4100 million users. This is approximately twice
the figures of January 2014.
(b) Explain why a user can still navigate from one web page to another web page in
the same amount of time as previously, even though the number of web pages is
significantly larger. [4]
The World Wide Web can be divided into the text web and the semantic web.
(c) Outline two reasons why there needs to be a balance between expressivity and
usability on the semantic web. [4]
The development of technologies that underpin the World Wide Web has led to the growth of
ambient intelligence and collective intelligence.
(d) Identify two features of ambient intelligence. [2]
(e) Evaluate the role of collective intelligence in the advancement of human knowledge. [6]
